# Forest Magic Workshop — Free Merge Icon Sample

This free sample contains 12 transparent 256 × 256 PNG icons selected from the full Forest Magic Workshop merge item icon pack.

## Included

- 6 White Bloom growth levels
- 3 resource producers
- 3 special-function items

## Full version

The complete pack contains 60 unique icons in four sizes: 90, 128, 256, and 512 px.

Get the full version on Cocos Store:

https://store.cocos.com/app/detail/9701
